name: Ageha
source:
Yet to take a customer, he studies the art of the courtesan under the tutelage of Gakuto. He is obedient and straightforward in his interactions with others. His only character flaw is his love of kissing with he becomes intoxicated.

(Taken from the [url=https://d3p.co.jp/ohgiya/en/]official English website[/url])
